title: 第14章 两枚戒指
slug: 史上第一祖师爷全本免费-史上第一祖师爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
萧焱居然有两枚戒指，这是林锋之前没预料到的情况，心里惴惴不安：“难道这萧焱竟然随身携带两个老爷爷？”
尼玛，教练，我要举报，这完全是犯规啊！
或许只有一枚戒指里有老爷爷，另外一个只是很普通的戒指？
林锋思索着，并非没有这个可能，甚至两个戒指都很普通，一个老爷爷都没有？
或者一个里面住着老爷爷，另外一个是什么隐藏神器之类的东西？
诸多疑问在林锋脑海中盘旋，百思不得其解，一边想着，一边已经跟在萧焱身后来到城北一个小湖边上。
林锋观察了一下周围环境，人很少，看来这是那萧焱的自留地，不顺心的时候会一个人来这里独处。
把这里记下，林锋暗暗点头，等到退婚之后，萧焱八成会一个人躲到这里舔伤口，然后就是老爷爷登场了。
湖边，黑衣少年双手背在头后面，脑袋枕着手，就这么在草地上躺了下来，嘴里叼着一根青草梗，一晃一晃的。
林锋站在远处望着萧焱，神色阴晴不定。
他现在开始认真思索如何在慕容嫣然退婚前，就先把萧焱收入门下，否则等到退婚事件发生，万一一次性激活了两个老爷爷，那压力就太大了。
林锋正想着，就见几个少年人向着萧焱走去，看样子不怀好意。
暗叹一声，林锋摇摇头，一脸怜悯。
他可不是怜悯萧焱虎落平阳被犬欺，而是感概那几人不知死活。
是，没错，萧焱现在正倒霉，看上去很好欺负，但要知道，欺负这种真命天子是要付出代价的。
等到退婚之后，萧焱立刻就会咸鱼翻身，眼前这些小角色，到时候人家打个喷嚏，都能崩飞几百个。
但无需等到萧焱咸鱼翻身，这些人现在就占不到便宜。
对于林锋来说，这完全是送上门来的机会。
低头检查了一下道袍，再扶正头上的星冠，确定自己的形象毫无瑕疵后，林锋干咳一声，准备出场。
“你们想切磋的话，无需萧焱哥哥出手，真儿跟你们过两招好了。”

林锋闻言险些踩在道袍上绊倒，连忙停下脚步，远远望去，就见一个身着紫色衣裙的少女，正俏生生的站在萧焱身前，静静看着那几个挑衅萧焱的人。
少女清冷淡然的气质，犹如清莲初绽，小小年纪，却已初具脱俗气质，难以想象，日后若是长大，少女将会如何的倾国倾城。
远处观望的林锋也暗赞了一声，此女小小年纪，已堪称绝色，更胜慕容嫣然半分，直逼那桃树妖胧夜，等到这个真儿再长大一些，怕是可以跟胧夜媲美了。
只是来的真不是时候。
林锋还没来得及遗憾，突然听见系统提示音响起：“发现目标，适合成为宿主亲传弟子。”
“嗯？难道说我转运了？”林锋一呆，继而大喜，目光再看向紫衣少女，就仿佛看着一只会下金蛋的金鸡。
“天赋系统整理完毕，三号目标资料如下。”
“根骨—>9；悟性—>8；心志—>7；福缘—>6。”
“总结：目标天赋高，建议收入门下，悉心教导，必为宗门栋梁。”
“特殊备注：目标目前修为高出宿主一个大境界。”
林锋乐呵呵的听着系统提示音，却在听到最后一句时愣住了。
高出我一个大境界，那不就是筑基期修士了？
林锋咽了咽口水，仔细观察紫衣少女，只见她周身法力充盈，形成一个循环，仿佛无穷无尽，正是练气十二层大圆满的标志。
练气十二层大圆满，十二个穴窍全部打通，整个连为一体，储存在穴窍中的法力不再像原来一样孤立成一滩滩死水，而是化为了一条奔腾的长江大河，在修真者体内不停运转。
一般来说，练气十二层的修真者，要远强于练气十一层。
但筑基期是完全不同的概念，如果说练气十二层大圆满是河的话，那筑基期就是大海了，两者不可同日而语。
虽然不管林锋怎么看，紫衣少女都是练气巅峰的修为，但既然系统说她是筑基期，林锋还是决定相信，谁知这小妮子有没有某种隐藏修为的手段？
知道这妮子是筑基期实力，林锋立刻打消了近期内设法收她为徒的念头。
原因无他，这妮子肯定是有大背景的。
十三、四岁就达到筑基期，这修练速度甚至比萧焱还要恐怖，两人的根骨和悟性相差不大，那就说明这紫衣少女从小得到的修练资源要比萧焱强出许多。

content_en:
Xiao Yan actually had two rings. This was something Lin Feng had not expected before. He felt uneasy: "Could it be that Xiao Yan actually carries two old men with him?"
Damn it, coach, I want to report it, this is totally a foul!
Maybe there's only one ring with the old man in it, and the other one is just an ordinary ring?
Lin Feng thought about it, it is not impossible, even the two rings are very ordinary, not even an old man has one?
Or maybe an old man lives in one, and the other is some kind of hidden artifact?
Many questions were swirling in Lin Feng's mind, and he was puzzled. While thinking about it, he followed Xiao Yan to the edge of a small lake in the north of the city.
Lin Feng observed the surrounding environment. There were very few people. It seemed that this was Xiao Yan's private place. When things didn't go his way, he would come here to be alone.
After writing this down, Lin Feng secretly nodded. After breaking off the engagement, Xiao Yan would most likely hide here alone to lick his wounds, and then the old man would appear.
By the lake, the young man in black put his hands behind his head and rested his head on his hands. He just lay down on the grass with a grass stem in his mouth, shaking it from side to side.
Lin Feng stood looking at Xiao Yan from a distance, his expression uncertain.
He now began to seriously think about how to take Xiao Yan into his sect before Murong Yanran broke off the engagement. Otherwise, when the breakup happened, the pressure would be too great if the two grandfathers were activated at once.
Just as Lin Feng was thinking about it, he saw several young people walking towards Xiao Yan, and they seemed to have evil intentions.
Sighing secretly, Lin Feng shook his head with a look of pity.
He didn't pity Xiao Yan for being bullied by dogs when he fell into Pingyang, but felt that those people didn't know whether to live or die.
Yes, that's right, Xiao Yan is unlucky now and seems easy to bully, but you must know that there is a price to pay for bullying such a right person.
After breaking off the engagement, Xiao Yan will immediately turn around. Hundreds of these little characters in front of him will fly away if they sneeze.
But there is no need to wait for Xiao Yan to turn over, these people will not be able to take advantage now.
For Lin Feng, this was an opportunity that just came to his door.
He lowered his head to check the Taoist robe, then straightened the star crown on his head. After making sure that his image was flawless, Lin Feng coughed dryly and prepared to appear.
"If you want to learn from each other, there is no need for brother Xiao Yan to take action. Zhen'er can fight with you two times."
Hearing this, Lin Feng almost tripped on the Taoist robe. He quickly stopped and looked from a distance. He saw a girl in a purple dress standing pretty in front of Xiao Yan, quietly looking at the people who provoked Xiao Yan.
The girl's cold and indifferent temperament is like the first bloom of a clear lotus. At such a young age, she has already begun to take on a refined temperament. It is hard to imagine how the girl will be able to enchant the country and the city if she grows up in the future.
Lin Feng, who was watching from a distance, also secretly praised her. At such a young age, this girl was already extremely beautiful, even half as beautiful as Murong Yanran, and almost as beautiful as the peach tree demon Lu Ye. When this Zhen'er grows older, she might be able to compete with Lu Ye.
It just didn't come at the right time.
Before Lin Feng had time to regret, he suddenly heard the system prompt sound: "The target has been found, suitable to become the host's direct disciple."
"Huh? Could it be that I've been lucky?" Lin Feng was stunned for a moment, then overjoyed, and looked at the girl in purple, as if looking at a golden rooster that lays golden eggs.
"The talent system has been sorted out. The information on target No. 3 is as follows."
“Genuity—>9; Comprehension—>8; Mind—>7; Blessings—>6.”
"Summary: The target has high talent. It is recommended to take him as a disciple and teach him carefully. He will definitely become a pillar of the sect."
"Special note: The target's current cultivation level is one level higher than that of the host."
Lin Feng listened to the system prompts happily, but was stunned when he heard the last sentence.
A level higher than mine, wouldn't he be a monk in the foundation-building stage?
Lin Feng swallowed and carefully observed the girl in purple. He saw that her whole body was filled with mana, forming a cycle.It seems to be endless, which is the symbol of the great perfection of the twelfth level of Qi training.
At the twelfth level of Qi training, all twelve acupoints are opened and connected as one. The mana stored in the acupoints is no longer isolated as a pool of stagnant water as before, but turns into a surging Yangtze River, constantly circulating in the cultivator's body.
Generally speaking, cultivators at the twelfth level of Qi training are much stronger than those at the eleventh level.
But the foundation building stage is a completely different concept. If the twelve levels of Qi training are like the river, then the foundation building stage is the sea. The two are not the same.
Although no matter what Lin Feng thought, the purple-clothed girl was at the peak of Qi training, but since the system said she was in the foundation-building stage, Lin Feng still decided to believe it. Who knows if this little girl has some way to hide her cultivation?
Knowing that this girl was in the foundation-building stage, Lin Feng immediately gave up the idea of ​​trying to take her as his disciple in the near future.
There is no other reason. This girl must have a big background.
She reached the foundation building stage at the age of thirteen or fourteen, and her training speed was even more terrifying than that of Xiao Yan. Their basic skills and understanding were not much different, which meant that the training resources the girl in purple had received since childhood were much stronger than Xiao Yan's.
